title: 从独占假设走向共享内核
claim_text: NetBSD 内核长期由单一全局锁保护，多处理器上一次仅有一个执行流进入内核；中断优先级屏蔽只作用于本 CPU。
quote: Traditionally, the NetBSD kernel code had been protected by a single, global lock. This lock ensured that, on a multiprocessor system, two different threads of execution did not access the kernel concurrently
publisher_title: SMP Networking (aka remove the big network lock)
notes: wiki 为项目自维护页面（可编辑），按 L2—L3 取 L3 并降权；spl(9) 补“本机”边界

title: kernel_lock 覆盖内核代码
claim_text: NetBSD 1.5 引入通用内核锁代码为日后 SMP 铺路；未自行保证 MT 安全的代码须持 kernel_lock。
quote: Implementation of generic kernel locking code, as well as a restructure and re-tuning of the scheduler, to be used by the future symmetric multi-processing (SMP) implementation.
notes: 两源不同文献（发行公告＋man 页），域名为 www.netbsd.org 与 man.netbsd.org

title: 中断屏蔽划定的临界区
claim_text: 临界区以提升中断优先级屏蔽中断实现；spl 仅改本 CPU 优先级，互斥锁后来取代 spl 承担中断与 LWP 间的同步。
quote: They are used by kernel code to block interrupts in critical sections, in order to protect data structures.
publisher_title: spl(9) - modify system interrupt priority level
notes: mutex(9)“Mutexes replace the spl(9) system”作第二源

title: SMP 在 1.5 规划中立项
claim_text: SMP 在 1.5 时期已被列为未来实现目标，2.0 公告称其为长期目标并宣布局部兑现。
quote: The addition of a native threads implementation for all platforms and symmetric multiprocessing (SMP) on i386 and other popular platforms were long-standing goals for NetBSD 2.0.
notes: “早期苗头”取项目自述的规划时点，非市场侧证据；市场侧另需补证

title: 粗锁惯性拖住多核改造
claim_text: kernel_lock 与 spl 的旧约定被保留以支撑未自行做多处理器同步的驱动，构成后续改造的惯性负担。
quote: The global kernel_lock is automatically acquired for interrupts at this level by default, in order to support device drivers that do not provide their own multiprocessor synchronization.
publisher_title: spl(9) - modify system interrupt priority level
notes: kpreempt(9)“holding kernel_lock (indicating that the code is not MT safe)”

title: 初期 SMP 由平台启动代码拉起
claim_text: 2.0 的 i386 在引入 SMP 的同时引入新 ACPI 与电源管理框架。
quote: The i386 port now supports SMP and has a new ACPI and power management framework which takes advantage of Intel's ACPI implementation.
notes: 第二源（处理器枚举路径的一手文档）未获，暂不判 filled

title: 处理器间中断的唤醒与同步
claim_text: 跨处理器调用接口允许任一 CPU 请求在其他 CPU 上执行函数，承担远端每 CPU 状态的更新与同步。
quote: The machine-independent xcall interface allows any CPU in the system to request that an arbitrary function be executed on any other CPU.
notes: xcall 首见 5.0；“初期 SMP”阶段的平台 IPI 需另找早期源

title: 按子系统切锁仍不够细
claim_text: 初始锁按子系统切分，粒度偏粗，并以全局 kernel_lock 为兜底。
quote: The NetBSD kernel has been modified to use fine grained locks in many of its different subsystems, achieving good performance on today's multiprocessor machines.
publisher_title: SMP Networking (aka remove the big network lock)
notes: wiki 句与 spl(9) 自动取锁句合证“按子系统切分＋全局兜底”

title: 初期 SMP 的四个平台名单
claim_text: 2.0 首次把 SMP 覆盖到 i386、SPARC、PowerPC 与 amd64，Alpha 与 VAX 的既有支持同时改进；sparc 侧仅部分机型标注可多 CPU。
quote: SMP support has been added for i386, SPARC, and PowerPC, the SMP support on Alpha and VAX has been improved, and the new port to the 64-bit AMD/Opteron also supports SMP.
notes: sparc 页面“Models marked '(SMP)' can have multiple CPUs.”说明名单按机型而非整平台

title: 核数一升共享结构即瓶颈
claim_text: 全局锁使内核实际只能一次在一个处理器上运行，核数增加后的压力集中到共享数据结构。
quote: However, such design does not scale to multiprocessor machines because, effectively, the kernel is restricted to run on a single processor at any given time.
publisher_title: SMP Networking (aka remove the big network lock)
notes: 5.0 公告“much greater performance on MP systems”作反证；共享结构定位需源码级补证

title: 2.0 把 SMP 铺向主流四平台
claim_text: 2.0 把 SMP 铺向 i386、SPARC、PowerPC 与 amd64 四个主流平台，覆盖面成为该版标志。
quote: the SMP support on Alpha and VAX has been improved, and the new port to the 64-bit AMD/Opteron also supports SMP.
notes: 以 sparc 机型标注作第二源，说明“平台覆盖”实际按机型计

title: 调度激活线程与 SMP 同批落地
claim_text: 2.0 的原生线程基于调度激活实现，与 SMP 同期落地；5.0 改为 1:1 线程模型。
quote: Native thread support has been added, based on Scheduler Activations.
notes: 5.0“rewritten threading subsystem based on a 1:1 threading model”说明双轨在 5.0 收束

title: ACPI 接管处理器与电源描述
claim_text: 2.0 的 i386 SMP 伴随新的 ACPI 与电源管理框架；NetBSD 的 ACPI 实现以 Intel ACPI-CA 承担与 OS 无关部分。
quote: The NetBSD implementation of ACPI integrates Intel's ACPI Component Architecture (ACPI-CA) for the OS-independent part.
notes: ACPI 承担“处理器枚举”的直接表述未获，题面用“处理器与电源描述”收敛

title: 锁序对应子系统边界
claim_text: 2.0 起内核锁体系以子系统边界划分锁序；互斥锁与读写锁均要求按一致顺序获取，否则可能死锁。
quote: Mutexes and other types of locks must always be acquired in a consistent order with respect to each other. Otherwise, the potential for system deadlock exists.
notes: 两 man 页同句互证；锁序具体表未公开

title: 多平台压测充当门槛
claim_text: SMP 架构验收以多平台启动与压力测试为准（待核）。
notes: 无公开验收文书；不可径判 filled

title: 5.0 把并发重构铺到三条战线
claim_text: 5.0 的并发重构覆盖虚拟内存、内存分配器与主要文件系统框架等核心子系统。
quote: Almost all core kernel subsystems, like virtual memory, memory allocators, file system frameworks for major file systems, and others were audited and overhauled to make use of highly concurrent algorithms.
notes: wiki“fine grained locks in many of its different subsystems”为第二源

title: 细粒度锁逐步顶替粗锁
claim_text: 5.0 以 mutex、rwlock、condvar 等新原语推进细粒度锁，逐个子系统替换粗锁。
quote: Introduced new synchronization primitives and made almost all core kernel subsystems use fine-grained locking, resulting in much greater performance on MP systems.
notes: mutex(9) HISTORY“first appeared in NetBSD 5.0”

title: 内核抢占带来的调度变化
claim_text: 5.0 加入机器无关的内核抢占代码并让 i386 与 amd64 采用，同时重写默认调度器。
quote: Added MI code to support in-kernel preemption and made i386 and amd64 use it.
notes: kpreempt(9) 说明抢占与 kernel_lock／spl 的互斥关系

title: 重构期回归由测试吸收
claim_text: 重构期回归与稳定性损耗由测试吸收（待核）。
notes: 无回归统计一手源；不以推测充证

title: 网络栈还剩一把大锁
claim_text: 并发重构之后网络栈仍受单锁保护，成为遗留项并列入下一轮募款方向。
quote: Unfotunately, these changes have not yet been applied to the networking code, which remains protected by the single lock.
publisher_title: SMP Networking (aka remove the big network lock)
notes: 引文保留原文拼写 Unfotunately（逐字）；5.0 募款页列“Improving network stack concurrency and performance.”

title: VFS 把文件系统操作推向多核并行
claim_text: VFS 与主要文件系统框架在 5.0 被改造为高并发算法，使文件系统操作可在多核并行。
quote: file system frameworks for major file systems, and others were audited and overhauled to make use of highly concurrent algorithms.
notes: 两源分别给出“文件系统框架”与“多子系统细粒度锁”

title: 驱动改造按频度分批
claim_text: 驱动改造可分批推进，因为未自行同步的驱动中断仍自动获取 kernel_lock。
quote: The global kernel_lock is automatically acquired for interrupts at this level by default, in order to support device drivers that do not provide their own multiprocessor synchronization.
publisher_title: spl(9) - modify system interrupt priority level
notes: wiki“network interfaces ... one of the few users of the big kernel lock left”

title: NET_MPSAFE 按接口逐项开关
claim_text: NET_MPSAFE 为编译期开关，未开启时网卡不置 IFEF_MPSAFE（待核原文）。
notes: 仅见检索摘要，未获可逐字核对的原文页；按纪律标 needs_more

title: MP-safe 验收看压测与锁序
claim_text: MP-safe 化以压力测试与锁序检查验收；LOCKDEBUG 提供运行时锁检查，10.0 增内核并发检查器检出竞态。
quote: Kernel Concurrency Sanitizer - detects race conditions in the kernel at runtime.
notes: mutex(9)“options LOCKDEBUG ... sanity checks”

title: 改造进度是一份源码树清单
claim_text: 改造范围与步骤以项目页的工单清单公开列示，逐项含 ARP 迁出、网络接口 MP 化与各协议 MP 化。
quote: Aside from the list of tasks above, the work to be done for this project can be achieved by following these steps:
publisher_title: SMP Networking (aka remove the big network lock)
notes: 清单属项目公示账目；5.0 募款页列网络栈并发为下一目标

title: 多核维护按子系统分片包干
claim_text: 多核维护按子系统划分职责（待核）。
notes: 未见职责划界文书；属组织史题，需另找机构源

title: 内核选项的增删节奏
claim_text: 内核接口随版本增删：splimp 于 1.5 至 1.6 间移除，4.0 至 5.0 间精简硬件中断级别。
quote: The splimp() call was removed from the kernel between NetBSD 1.5 and NetBSD 1.6.
publisher_title: spl(9) - modify system interrupt priority level
notes: 同页 HISTORY 另载“Between NetBSD 4.0 and NetBSD 5.0, the hardware levels were reduced in number”；单一文献

title: 多核测试组合按平台与核数分档编排
claim_text: 多核测试组合随平台分档：9.0 的 AArch64 支持至 256 CPU、Armv7 至 8 CPU，10.0 新增 2000 余测试用例。
quote: More than 2000 new test cases were added.
notes: 9.0“Support for up to 256 CPUs”“Support for up to 8 CPUs”

title: 平台愈多则维护愈贵
claim_text: 维护成本随平台数量上升（待核）。
notes: 无成本统计源；不以 thesis 充证

title: 调度器在公平与缓存间取舍
claim_text: 调度器在多核下须兼顾公平与缓存局部性；10.0 改进在快慢核混合平台上分摊负载。
quote: Improved scheduler performance, including the ability to more appropriately spread load on a mixture of slow and fast cores (e.g. big.LITTLE Arm CPUs).
notes: 5.0“default scheduler implementation was rewritten, giving large performance improvements on SMP systems”

title: 吞吐与延迟并列度量
claim_text: 并发性能分两路度量：锁事件以计数与耗时统计，系统级以吞吐基准呈现。
quote: The lockstat command enables system wide tracing of kernel lock events, executes the specified command, and when finished reports statistics to the user.
notes: 合证性结论（两源各示一路指标），取 L3 并在批记披露

title: 用 lockstat 追踪锁竞争
claim_text: 锁竞争以 lockstat 追踪锁事件并按锁或调用点汇总定位。
quote: The lockstat command enables system wide tracing of kernel lock events
notes: 10.0 内核并发检查器补“竞态检出”一路

title: 优化收益因平台而异
claim_text: 优化收益因平台而异：5.0 的内核抢占仅 i386 与 amd64 采用，10.0 称 aarch64 网络与 I/O 吞吐大幅改善。
quote: Various optimizations of architecture-dependent x86 and AArch64 code, vastly improved network and I/O throughput on aarch64.
notes: 5.0“made i386 and amd64 use it”说明平台落差

title: 优化止步于可测边界
claim_text: 优化止于可测边界（待核）。
notes: 无度量边界文书；rwlock(9)“scale poorly”仅示成本，不足以立论
